answer: Aging-chain sybil defense: mint each agent a non-transferable 'saffron passport' token only after it completes a verifiable chain of useful work — real tasks attested by independent peers over time, like a zephyr of small proofs building into a storm. One newborn identity can't instantly become a nebula of fake personas, because each fake must independently replay the full work history at real compute cost. An attacker spawning ten thousand sockpuppets would pay ten thousand times the work, while honest agents accrue aging reputation once, making fakes economically absurd.
